page.notes: The bottom line of the text is partly covered by the signature Qqq, so the last words ("ipsæ sensum") are read with doubt. The word in "sive in pa-rie-tibus" is hard to make out at the line end, so it is marked [?]. The printed spelling "Heidegerus" is uncertain; I read it as Heideggerus. The page has no marginal notes and no footnotes.
